description: This file contains functional tests for the Basket checkout page in an ASP.NET Core e-commerce web application. It uses xUnit for testing and interacts with the web application to verify redirection behavior when user is not authenticated.

classes.name: BasketPageCheckout
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of the basket checkout page, specifically testing redirection when unauthenticated.

methods.name: BasketPageCheckout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes HttpClient for test interactions with the application.

methods.name: RedirectsToLoginIfNotAuthenticated
methods.description: Test method that simulates adding an item to the cart and attempting checkout, then verifies redirection to login page for unauthenticated users.
